pet_notes: Kusanagi Nene, card 886 trained Queen of Heart. Long pale sage-green hair and lavender-purple eyes. Small upright gold crown with red heart jewels. Dark emerald-green fitted short lolita dress above the knees, gold piping, ivory layered lace underskirt and ruffled hem. Short rich-red cape with fluffy ivory collar, cream cravat bow, rose/pink heart medallion and red-black diamond accents. Opaque black tights; dark-green low boots with white frilled cuffs and small gold diamond detail. White lace wrist cuffs with emerald ribbons. Retain a single red rose in her anatomical right hand (screen-left in front view) and one small white red-heart playing card in left hand (screen-right). Both props remain attached to hands, close to body. Reserved gentle expression, quiet confident stage presence. Standing full body, compact short legs, preserve garment silhouette and asymmetry. Gentle 8px hop maximum at final cell size; never a high leap. No chair, animals, scenery, floating cards or extra props.
